discovery.notes: Carrefour declares the food sitemap index in its own robots.txt. Use it as the canonical first-party product identity/URL discovery route before category crawling.

pipelines.notes: Direct urllib Carrefour scraper; limited roots and mixes extraction with classification. Preserve for history, do not use as the canonical first-party staging format.
Direct Playwright Carrefour adapter. Historical smoke discovered categories but zero product URLs; useful as a probe, not as the canonical first-party dataset.
Traverses Carrefour's official sitemap-food index, records retailer SKU, canonical product URL and sitemap last-modified evidence, and persists JSONL plus SQLite without any Rumbo classification.

Extraction-only HTTP staging. Stores product fields, partial nutrition and field-level evidence fetched from carrefour.es; performs no Rumbo classification. GitHub-hosted direct HTTP is currently answered with 403 by Carrefour.

Polite real-browser fallback for Carrefour product pages. Extracts only fields observed directly on carrefour.es, records per-field evidence, captures candidate first-party JSON/XHR endpoints, persists JSONL plus SQLite, and stops after a WAF block rather than hammering the site.

rules: May seed candidate Carrefour product URLs/identities.
Never copy a RadarSuper field into CARREFOUR_FIRST_PARTY evidence.
Open Food Facts nutrition surfaced by RadarSuper remains OPEN_FOOD_FACTS_VIA_RADARSUPER and is never DECLARED Carrefour evidence.

aesan_or_manufacturer.rule: Keep separate provenance; not part of the Carrefour first-party pass.

classification_policy: Extraction is independent of Rumbo classification. Automatic proposals are not manual semantic review and are not first-party retailer evidence.
